summary: Created Thought Evolution Memory to track app UX, pipeline changes, agents/prompts/harness, creative variables, weights, novelty, and skill updates.
next_actions: Surface visual_judge and variable_rationale in Content Studio UX.
Track creative novelty per generated content set.
Add model-backed reviewer routing after local deterministic gates.

summary: Fixed Content Studio carousel review path: rendered_pdf_path now becomes an API pdf_url and the app embeds carousel PDFs instead of showing Visual pending.
lesson: Rendered assets are not reviewable until their lineage is exposed from queue record to API detail to UI preview; /thought should treat a hidden asset as a pipeline failure, not a missing asset.
next_actions: Expose visual_judge and variable_rationale next to image and carousel previews.
Add a regression check that every visual content type has at least one visible review asset.

summary: Replaced fragile embedded-PDF carousel review with native slide previews and kept the PDF as an explicit export/open action.
lesson: A generated PDF being downloadable is not enough; the review cockpit needs native, always-visible slide previews because embedded PDF viewers can fail or render blank in browser shells.
next_actions: Make carousel_slides part of the API contract documentation.
Expose variable rationale beside each slide preview.

summary: Added Instagram Carousel as a first-class Thought Studio format, changed carousel cards into compact slide-strip previews, and made PDF routes download artifacts instead of review pages.
lesson: Platform-native review must separate review UI from export artifacts: LinkedIn can use PDF export, while Instagram carousel needs slide-sequence review and eventually per-slide image export.
next_actions: Implement rendered_slide_paths for Instagram carousel PNG/JPG exports.
Show variable rationale and judge reasons next to each carousel preview.

summary: Added posting_destination lineage to Thought Studio records/API and surfaced the configured account route in the content detail drawer before visual review and approval actions.
lesson: In a multi-account system, platform is not enough review context; approval UX must show destination account, language route, approval requirement, and data lineage before any publish or schedule action.
next_actions: Extend Holus Social API publish/schedule contracts with explicit account routing.
Show destination account on queue cards and generated-set cards, not only the detail drawer.

summary: Replaced the carousel detail drawer thumbnail grid with an inspector: large selected slide, Previous/Next controls, thumbnail rail, inline Open PDF, and separate Download PDF.
lesson: Carousel review needs a readable inspection surface; compact slide strips are useful in overview cards but fail the approval job inside the drawer.
next_actions: Add per-slide variable rationale beside the active slide.
Export Instagram carousel as per-slide images instead of PDF-only review artifacts.

summary: Replaced the status-column review queue with thought-level review groups. Each raw thought now shows its generated outputs together, deduped to latest output per platform/content type, with version counts for reruns.
lesson: Thought Studio review should be organized by the user's thought, not workflow status; status is metadata on each generated output, not the primary navigation model.
next_actions: Rename ContentKanban to ThoughtSetReview for clearer ownership.
Move the separate visual/copy featured sections into the same thought-set review surface.

summary: Ran a Claude Opus 4.8 read-only review of Thought Studio agent wiring, then added a Content Studio agent dashboard that separates registry entries, current-run trace, active-but-unused agents, evaluator idleness, model lanes, prompt versions, and stored telemetry gaps.
lesson: The other agents are mostly registered prompt definitions, not broken workers. Thought Studio currently uses a deterministic pipeline with hardcoded trace names; a full fleet requires AgentRegistry/PromptLoader routing, model-backed stage calls, evaluator passes, and durable trajectory telemetry.
next_actions: Make Thought Studio registry-driven instead of hardcoded trace-driven.
Wire evaluator agents as model-backed judges with redo loops.
Persist prompt_sha, prompt_version, model, latency, cost, scores, and output hashes per agent stage.
